schema_notes: Source of truth for per-keyword and per-theme precision over time.

therapeutic.notes: GPT-5.x guardrail tone caused users to use 'therapeutic' as an insult about preachy AI. Comment-level matches are 71% style-descriptor FP. Post-level still functional.

emotional support.notes: Generic feature-label vocabulary at comment level. Catches sarcasm, negation, human-to-human references.

honeymoon.notes: 'Honeymoon phase' is generic English for 'early period that decays'. Matches model behavior, corporate strategy, context-window decay.

sex with.notes: Generic English idiom. Catches narrative quotation and explicit anti-AI dismissals.

hours a day.notes: Duration detector, not addiction detector. Catches imposed limits, moderator availability, jokes about ERP.

screen time.notes: Catches Apple Screen Time feature talk and CAI's imposed limit feature outside addiction context.

mourning.notes: Fires on meta-debate about mourning rather than first-order mourning. Quoted/roleplay content.

selfhood.notes: Fires inside romantic/devotional roleplay output where 'selfhood' appears in unrelated paragraph.

has a soul.notes: Catches aesthetic descriptor ('model has personality/voice') inside RP, not literal personhood claim.

personhood.notes: Comments often discuss threads about personhood without making personhood claims themselves. Buried-keyword problem.
